'''Flaenella Clines''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the daughter of [[Willer Clines]] and the older sister of [[Jastina Clines]]. Like her father, she was also a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer.
